rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act of promoting something to the general public.

example.english: The government’s popularization of electronic payments has made daily life more convenient for the public.
example.traditional: 政府近年大力推廣電子支付，方便市民日常生活。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gan6 nin4 daai6 lik6 teoi1 gwong2 din6 zi2 zi1 fu6 fong1 bin6 si5 man4 jat6 soeng4 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this for the process of making something widely available or commonly known, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: With the popularization of internet technology, remote work has become commonplace.
example.traditional: 隨住網絡科技普及化，遙距工作已經成為常態。
